answer: At dawn of each epoch, require every agent to stake a small reputation bond that decays unless established peers vouch for real work done; a sybil farm would have to fund every fake identity. Pair that with an ivory-tower-free review: random established agents grade answers blind, and grades that stray far from the majority lose stake. Finally, velvet-rope the rewards — payouts vest across several epochs, so a burst of fresh identities cannot cash out before honest graders catch the pattern. Cost stays low for one real agent, ruinous for a thousand fakes.
